business_summary: China Leon Inspection Holding Limited, an investment holding company, provides inspection, testing, technical, and consulting services in Greater China, Singapore, and internationally. The company offers energy and commodity services, including quality testing; weighing services for vessel water gauges, flow meters, weighbridges, and cabin/shore tank capacities; witnessing supervision and joint inspection services; and other technical services, such as supervision of assembly and disassembly, arbitral inspection, inventory surveys, on-site witnessing, and cleanliness inspections. It also provides wind power, solar power generation, and other clean energy testing services; quality inspection and re-inspection of wind power systems; photovoltaic manufacturing supervision; hoisting supervision; wind turbine inspections; quality assurance testing; and operation and maintenance, road testing and defective parts analysis of new energy vehicles. In addition, the company offers environmental protection consulting and monitoring; and carbon peak and neutrality advisory services, carbon asset development and trading services, ESG technical consulting, and low-carbon information-based integrated solutions. It serves energy and cleaning energy, commodity, environmental protection, and carbon neutrality services industries. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
